Players Committee card image of [[DS-61-5 (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots, 3 when piloting Black 5. While piloting Black 5, it is maneuver +1 and he draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If at opponent's system, instead of Force draining here, may take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.”
